sv_benchmarks.note: Tasks are copied with their .yml trimmed to the task's property (`property`, no-data-race where it names none); the .yml of an original task is c/<origin>. Licences are those of the task's directory (SPDX header or LICENSE file), texts in c/LICENSES/.

sv_comp_2026_source: verified and validated result XMLs of Goblint, Dartagnan, ULTIMATE Automizer in C.no-data-race.Concurrency, 2026-01; cpu_s is CPU time of the component's own run

goblint-1s.purpose: Goblint with a CPU-time limit of 1 s in phase 1, then Dartagnan and ULTIMATE Automizer in phase 2, on a task where a level of Goblint's portfolio reaches it: the limit ends that level, the runner gives up the rest, and phase 2 answers.

tasks.name: goblint-regression/28-race_reach_41-trylock_racefree
tasks.purpose: Goblint answers true in 0.1 s; neither Dartagnan nor ULTIMATE Automizer answers, so only a working Goblint can give the verdict.

tasks.name: pthread-theta/unwind3-100
tasks.purpose: Goblint answers true; the others do not.

tasks.name: goblint-regression/28-race_reach_01-simple_racing
tasks.purpose: Goblint answers true; the others do not.

tasks.name: pthread-divine/tls_basic
tasks.purpose: Dartagnan answers true; Goblint gives unknown and ULTIMATE Automizer no answer.

tasks.name: pthread-divine/tls_destructor_worker
tasks.purpose: Dartagnan answers true; the others do not.

tasks.name: pthread-divine/ring_1w1r-1
tasks.purpose: Dartagnan answers false and Theta's validator confirms its witness (ULTIMATE Automizer's validator reaches the 90 s limit on it); the others give no answer. Goblint ends in unknown after 2.2 s CPU time.

tasks.name: goblint-regression/09-regions_01-list_rc
tasks.purpose: Dartagnan answers false on a .c task (preprocessed by the component) and ULTIMATE Automizer's validator confirms its witness; Goblint ends in unknown after 0.8 s and ULTIMATE Automizer times out. Replaces pthread-divine/ring_1w1r-2, where Goblint's own run needs 169 s CPU time to end in unknown, which with a working Goblint in front of Dartagnan exceeds the suite's 100 s limit.

tasks.name: ldv-races/race-4_1-thread_local_vars
tasks.purpose: The only task of the category on which ULTIMATE Automizer alone answers true; the heaviest task of the suite (42 s CPU in SV-COMP 2026).

tasks.name: pthread-theta/unwind2-nondet
tasks.purpose: ULTIMATE Automizer answers true, Dartagnan does not; Goblint answers it in its own entry, so a Goblint that works hides ULTIMATE Automizer in a configuration that starts with Goblint.

tasks.name: goblint-regression/04-mutex_50-funptr_rc
tasks.purpose: ULTIMATE Automizer alone answers false on a .c task (preprocessed by the component) that calls a function through a pointer; Theta's validator confirms its witness.

tasks.name: goblint-regression/04-mutex_21-sound_base
tasks.purpose: ULTIMATE Automizer alone answers false on a .c task (preprocessed by the component); ConcurrentWitness2Test confirms its witness.

tasks.name: lp64/race-only-on-lp64
tasks.purpose: A data race only when sizeof(long) == 8: expected false under LP64.  ULTIMATE Automizer answers true if given ILP32, so CoOpeRace must pass the task's data model. ULTIMATE Automizer's validator confirms the witnesses of both owners.

tasks.name: lp64/race-only-on-ilp32
tasks.purpose: The same program with the indices swapped: no race under LP64, expected true; ULTIMATE Automizer given ILP32 reports a race.

tasks.name: goblint-regression/04-mutex_19-call_by_ptr_rc
tasks.purpose: Run by goblint-1s only. A level of Goblint's portfolio uses more than 1 s of CPU time, so the 1 s limit ends it (goblint exited with code -24) and the runner gives up the remaining levels; Dartagnan answers false in phase 2 and ULTIMATE Automizer's validator confirms its witness. ULTIMATE Automizer also answers false, with 20.6 s of CPU time against Dartagnan's 8.6 s in SV-COMP 2026, so CoOpeRace normally stops it. Goblint's own run needs 54 s to end in unknown, too long for the other configurations.

tasks.name: libvsync/clhlock
tasks.purpose: sv-sanitizers answers false(valid-deref) in 0.4 s; Goblint ends in unknown after 7.9 s and Deagle in unknown after 0.4 s, so in the valid-memsafety strategy only sv-sanitizers gives the verdict. Its witness has one target waypoint and is of format 2.0, which does not pass the check; a valid-memsafety false needs none, so CoOpeRace prints the false without a witness. No validator of the suite checks valid-memsafety.

tasks.name: pthread/bigshot_s
tasks.purpose: Deagle answers true in 0.2 s; Goblint ends in unknown after 0.7 s and sv-sanitizers reaches the time limit, so in the valid-memsafety strategy only Deagle gives the verdict, in phase 2 after sv-sanitizers' CPU-time limit. A valid-memsafety true needs no witness.

tasks.name: pthread/singleton
tasks.purpose: Deagle answers false(unreach-call) in 0.2 s with a YAML violation witness, error-witness.yml; Goblint ends in unknown after 1.0 s and Dartagnan answers false after 8.6 s. An unreach-call false needs a YAML 2.2 violation witness, so CoOpeRace prints Deagle's false only if its witness passes the check. No validator of the suite checks unreach-call.

tasks.name: pthread/queue
tasks.purpose: iekke 1.0 answered true in 29 s in SV-COMP 2026, and Goblint, Deagle and Dartagnan reached the time limit. iekke 2.0 (10.5281/zenodo.23243599) gives no answer on any task: its wrapper opens output_unwind_rounds.csv, which its archive does not contain, and ends with a FileNotFoundError, so check 2 fails here until iekke's archive is fixed.
